Frequently Asked Questions

close
close
  • What is a Faculty?
    add_circle_outline
    Faculty is an admin account with limited privileges. The Super Admin (your account) can create multiple faculty accounts to manage students and create exams and scan OMRs for OMR exams.
  • What can a Faculty do?
    add_circle_outline
    A Faculty Account can manage students assigned to them. A set of Students are assigned via a combination of one or more Classes, Centres & Groups.
    Faculty can also manually evaluate subjective exams by assigning marks to them, so that the Admin doesn't have to do all the evaluation.
    They can also scan OMRs as OMR Exams added in the system can be seen by Faculty in the EzOMR App once they login with their phone numbers.
  • Can Faculties scan OMRs?
    add_circle_outline
    When a Faculty is created, an EzOMR App account is automatically created for that phone number. They can then login to the App and scan OMRs for any OMR exams created. This helps distribute the load between the Admin and Faculty while scanning OMRs, making it easier.
  • Where and how do Faculties Login?
    add_circle_outline
    After being added by the Admin, Faculties login at the institute portal like Admin & Students at institute-name.ezexam.in using their 10 digit Phone Number
    They can also login to the EzOMR App with their phone number to see OMR exams and scan OMRs.
  • Can a Faculty be deleted or disabled after adding?
    add_circle_outline
    Yes Admin can Delete or set a Faculty as Inactive at any time from the Faculty table above.

Frequently Asked Questions

close
  • What is a Student Account?
    add_circle_outline
    Students or Test takers can login to the Online Exams platform with their pre-assigned roll numbers or phone numbers. They can also signup with their phone numbers, which creates their account. It’s usually accessed on the institute’s portal, like institute-name.ezexam.in
    It is an online account on their institute’s portal where they can take online exams, view analytics of completed exams and other features like notice board, pdf notes, video sharing etc.,
  • How is a Student Account created?
    add_circle_outline
    Can be created by Admins, added one at a time or in bulk via an excel file. Accounts can also be created by Students by signing up with their phone numbers, after which students can login with their phone number.
    Student IDs are auto assigned when Students Signup with their phone numbers. An OTP is generated to verify the phone number and after verification, a Student account is created.
  • Where do Students Login to take Exams?
    add_circle_outline
    Students login at the same web-portal that admins login, which looks like your-name.ezexam.in
    They can login using their Student ID or using their phone number, if it was added by the admin or they signed up with it.
    Students can use any device to login, including phones, tablets, laptops, desktops etc.,
  • What features are available in the Student Account?
    add_circle_outline
    The Student account is used to take online exams, view scores & analytics and other LMS features like PDF notes & Institute Notices. EzExam is the free test maker online. Other custom features are also available based on the requirements of the Institute admin.
  • On what devices can Students access the platform?
    add_circle_outline
    The platform can be accessed on all devices - Desktops, Laptops, Smart phones & Tablets.
    On Desktops & Laptops, the platform can be accessed (by both Students & Admins) in the Chrome Web browser. For mobiles and tablets, EzExam App is available to take online exams, view analytics and everything else. It is the free test maker online. Admins use the online test maker, and students take the exam on their devices. Admin can also create free test online.
    Students can also switch devices while giving an exam and the exam will seamlessly continue on the new device. Similarly they can be logged in to the same account on multiple devices.
  • Can students set or change their passwords?
    add_circle_outline
    Yes students have a provision to change their passwords at any time, either before logging in through an OTP or from within the platform. When Admins add students in bulk via a CSV file, the passwords of the newly created student accounts are equal to their respective roll numbers.
  • Can students be added in bulk?
    add_circle_outline
    Yes students can be added via an Excel file by which their student accounts are created. Note that a Student ID is required for every student and by default, their passwords are their roll numbers when accounts are created. These students are selected in the online test maker, along with question papers, to take online exams. Admins can also create free test online.
  • What fields can students have?
    add_circle_outline
    Students have a Student ID, which is a constant. Every student has a Class, Centre & one or more Groups. For example, a student can be in Class/Standard - 10, at Centre - South, Mumbai, and belong to a Group called IIT-JEE.
    The online test creator uses these fields to assign online exams.
    Email & Phone numbers can also be added, and are useful to recover forgotten passwords, but not mandatory to add.Admins can edit these fields at any time as required.
    To edit students in bulk, Admins can add a CSV file with updated values for corresponding roll numbers, and the various fields in student accounts will be updated.
  • What are Class, Centre & Group?
    add_circle_outline
    Class or Standard is a number showing the standard of the student, for example 11 indicates, 11th Standard. It can also refer to a batch year like 2021 Batch.
    Centre refers to the location of the student, it can hold a Centre name & City name, for example “Hauz-Khas, New Delhi”
    Group or branch can be any descriptor to group students, for example IIT, NEET, CET, Olympiad etc.,
    The online test maker also uses these three fields to select students and create online exams. Admins get the online test creator free. These fields are required to add a student, but can be changed later at any time as mentioned in the previous point.
  • Can a Student Account be edited or deleted?
    add_circle_outline
    Admins can edit all the above mentioned fields by clicking on the student’s name in the Students table. A student account can be disabled by the Admin anytime, preventing the student from logging in to the account. Admins also have access to the online exam maker. This online exam maker chooses Students and a question paper to create Online Exams for students. Deleting a Student also deletes all associated Student Analytics data.
  • Is there a limit to the number of Student Accounts?
    add_circle_outline
    There is no limit to the number of Student Accounts, any number can be created.
  • Do Students have to pay anything?
    add_circle_outline
    No, the students will never have to pay anything.
  • Can Admins access Student Pages?
    add_circle_outline
    Yes, they can create online exam and go to the student’s page and check if it’s accessible to the student. It’s important for Admins to create online exams and check start and end dates & times to see if it’s visible in the Student account.
    Admins can also see student performance along with all exam analytics at any time.
  • Can Students access the online exam creator?
    add_circle_outline
    No, only the Admins can access the online exam creator and students do not have access to it. The online exam conducting software is managed by the institute admins and students cannot change any data apart from their own names and passwords.
    If a student wants to change their phone number, a message can be sent to the Admin who can update it on their behalf. Student roll numbers cannot be changed, either by admins or students.
  • How does the exam maker or exam creator work?
    add_circle_outline
    EzExam provides a free online exam creator which takes a set of questions and assigns it to a group of students, accessible at a certain time interval. After this interval is done, analytics are generated with scores, ranks, percentiles and much more. There is no exam limit for this free online exam creator and unlimited number of exams can be created.
  • How does the Question Bank feature work?
    add_circle_outline
    Everytime exams are added to the system, the individual questions are automatically added into a question database also called a question bank. This question bank gives the admins & faculty members access to all the questions added to the portal. These questions can be listed by Subject, Topic, Difficulty, Exam-Type and their combinations. Various other data is also stored, like the number of times a question was used in various online exams and their details.
    This is relevant, for example, when you don’t want to reuse the same question which was used most recently in an online exam. Once the questions are listed, they can be picked manually to create a new question paper, after a Name and duration is assigned. The obvious advantage of this is that question papers need not be constantly added to a system, instead the same questions and various combinations of them can be reused as per the requirement. Note that for this to be effective, tagging questions by Subject, Topic and Difficulty is recommended but not mandatory.
    Can the Question Bank feature auto select questions per student from a limited question pool? This feature, to assign every student a different set of questions from a limited question pool is currently under development and will be ready to use in a few weeks time. In this case it is mandatory for questions to be tagged with Topic and Difficulty so that all students’ exams have roughly the same difficulty level and range of topics.

Frequently Asked Questions

close
close
  • What is a Notice?
    add_circle_outline
    Notices are simply messages which can be shared with a group of Students by the Admin.
    These Notices appear in the Student accounts and are visible when they login, in their Notices page. Notices contain a Title and a Message body which the Admin can enter.
  • Can a Notice be shared with a single Student?
    add_circle_outline
    Yes after selecting from which date a notice should show, Students can be selected using a combination of Class, Centre & Groups.
    Among the students in the selection, all or a few or even a single student can be selected (using the blue Toggle button) and only they will see the notice in their Student account when they login.
  • Can Notices be Edited or Deleted after creating?
    add_circle_outline
    Yes Notices can be edited or deleted at anytime after adding them. Do note that students might have already seen the notice if you're deleting after it's shown to them.
  • Is there a limit to the number of Notices that can be created?
    add_circle_outline
    There is no limit to the number of Notices, any number can be created.
  • Can Faculty create Notices?
    add_circle_outline
    Yes Faculty can create Notices but only share it with their own Students which were assigned by the Admin to the Faculty.
  • Can Students create Notices?
    add_circle_outline
    No, only the Admins can access this page and create Notices.

Frequently Asked Questions

close
close
  • What are the limitations of the Free Plan?
    remove_circle

    In the Free Plan, upto 25 Student Accounts can be created. These could either be through Admin adding them or Students signing up via an Exam Link

    A total of 25 Exam Attempts can be taken by these Students within 31 days after the Admin account was created

  • How does the Paid Plan work?
    add_circle_outline

    Simply select the number of Student Accounts you require and purchase them for either 1 Month or 1 Year with 20% Discount

    These Students can now take any number of Exam Attempts in the selected time duration. Student accounts can be deleted and added again, only the Total number of Students are counted.

  • What are the benefits of this Paid Plan?
    add_circle_outline

    With this Paid Plan, Students can take any number of Exam Attempts and tracking Attempts usage is no longer required

    Just need to ensure that you have enough student capacity allocated, and create any number of Exams for your Students

    Can also get 20% discount with Annual purchases, with the flexibility to also increase Student Capacity in between, before the Plan ends.

  • Can Student Capacity be changed before a Paid Plan ends?
    add_circle_outline

    Yes, Student Capacity can be increased before an existing Paid Plan end. Can simply select the new Capacity, and get a reduction of the value of remaining Paid Plan.

    For Example, Let's say you have paid Rs.1500 for 100 Students for 1 Month and need to increase capacity after HALF a month, before the Plan completes. Then in the new purchase, you will get a reduction of Rs.750 (Rs.1500/2) which is the value of the remaining HALF month.

  • Do the same Student Accounts have to continue the Plan or can they be removed?
    add_circle_outline

    Only the Total number of Students are counted, you can remove Students who no longer need Exams and Add new ones within your Paid Student Capacity.

  • Will a GST Invoice be provided?
    add_circle_outline

    Yes a GST invoice will be provided with your company data and GSTIN, simply contact us on 91 0001 8780 or support@ezexam.in to get it

  • What happens to my Data after a Paid Plan expires?
    add_circle_outline

    After a Paid Plan expires, upto 25 Students' data is kept for 1 year.

    If there are more than 25 Students, then the Student & Analytics data is kept for 3 months, before which another Paid Plan must be started or the data will be archived.

  • Is my data Private on EZexam?
    add_circle_outline

    We take Data Privacy very seriously and rest assured, your data, be it your content or student data, is not shared with anyone, in any manner by EZexam
    Institute or Student data is not monetized by us and it is not part of our business model.
    Your data is yours and only you have access to it, no one else can view it in whole or parts.
    We can even sign NDAs (Non-Disclosure Agreements) with Institutes or Organizations if they so choose.

  • Can Students view their Exam Scores & Analytics?
    add_circle_outline

    Yes, students login to the same portal as you do, on any device, with their Roll Numbers or Phone Numbers (if added).
    Here they will be able to take Exams, view Scores & Analytics after the exam is taken.

  • Can Offline Exams be conducted on EZexam?
    add_circle_outline

    Yes, offline MCQ exams can be conducted using OMRs and the EzOMR App is used to evaluate them. All this is integerated into your EZexam portal.
    Simply select an OMR PDF to print from over 20 OMRs, which can be found when creating an OMR exam.
    Then after conducting the exam, scan the OMRs using the EzOMR App for which your account is already created.
    These OMRs are evaluated and automatically appear in your exam in this portal, with scores and corrected OMR images.

  • Can EZexam be customized?
    add_circle_outline

    Yes your EZexam portal address can be customized with your name, like my-institute.ezexam.in and the colors and logos can be set.
    Web-App icon can also be set for mobile devices, giving it a customized look like it's your own website.
    This customization is free of charge.

Frequently Asked Questions

close
close
  • What kinds of Exams are supported on EZexam?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    All common examinations held in India are supported, including IIT-JEE, NEET, CET, GATE, GRE and many more.
    These include latest advanced features such as answering 10 of 15 questions in a section, calculators for GRE/GATE, setting timer per section and many more.
    Offline OMR Exams can also be created with EZexam and the EzOMR App is also included, which is used to scan and evaluate OMRs and the results are automatically sent to your EZexam account.

  • What kinds of questions are supported on EZexam?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Exams can have questions with one or more of the following types:

    • Multiple Choice Questions (single or multi-correct) with 4, 5 or 6 options (ABCD, ABCDE, ABCDEF) are supported.
    • Numercial Questions with Integer (2), Decimal (2.45) or Fractional (2/5) Keys are supported.
    • Subjective exams where Students type in Input or upload Photos with written reponses are supported. For these Exams, Admins have to manually assign marks per question after the exam is submitted by the Student.
    • True or False Questions are supported
    • Audio Questions are also supported
    • Many special types of Exams with 10 of 15 questions to attempt or 5 of 10 questions to attempt are supported.

  • Does EZexam provide Question Content?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    EZexam is an Online Exam System, we do not provide any content for Exams.
    All the Questions required for an exam have to be added by the Institute Admins.

  • Are there any limitations to EZexam usage?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    EZexam is made to be scalable and any number of Students can take exams on it simultaneously.
    Any number of Exams can be created, without limits
    Any number of Students can be added, without limits
    100 Attempts per month are Free and beyond that, can purchase Attempts per your requirement for as low as Rs.1/attempt when you add 2500 Attempts.

  • Is my data Secure on EZexam?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    All data transfer on EZexam is completely encrypted using SSL which can be seen in the lock symbol in the address bar
    EZexam runs on industry leading servers with state-of-the-art security.
    Rest assured your data is absolutely secure on EZexam and has been for all our clients, since our inception over 5 years ago.

  • Is my data Private on EZexam?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    We take Data Privacy very seriously and rest assured, your data, be it your content or student data, is not shared with anyone, in any manner by EZexam
    Institute or Student data is not monetized by us and it is not part of our business model.
    Your data is yours and only you have access to it, no one else can view it in whole or parts.
    We can even sign NDAs (Non-Disclosure Agreements) with Institutes or Organizations if they so choose.

  • Can Students view their Exam Scores & Analytics?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Yes, students login to the same portal as you do, on any device, with their Roll Numbers or Phone Numbers (if added).
    Here they will be able to take Exams, view Scores & Analytics after the exam is taken.

  • Can Offline Exams be conducted on EZexam?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Yes, offline MCQ exams can be conducted using OMRs and the EzOMR App is used to evaluate them. All this is integerated into your EZexam portal.
    Simply select an OMR PDF to print from over 20 OMRs, which can be found when creating an OMR exam.
    Then after conducting the exam, scan the OMRs using the EzOMR App for which your account is already created.
    These OMRs are evaluated and automatically appear in your exam in this portal, with scores and corrected OMR images.

  • Can EZexam be customized?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Yes your EZexam portal address can be customized with your name, like my-institute.ezexam.in and the colors and logos can be set.
    Web-App icon can also be set for mobile devices, giving it a customized look like it's your own website.
    This customization is free of charge.

Frequently Asked Questions

close
  • What is an Exam Link?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Exams can be shared via a short link (like ezex.in/abcdef) such that anyone with the link will be able to signup or login and take the exam.
    This is useful when Students are not added to the system before-hand and you'd like them to create their own Student Accounts by signing up.
    The Students who signup or login with the link and start time exam, their Attempts will appear in the next tab at the top, called Attempts.
    Note that if you want only a fixed set of Students to take the exam, they need to be added first in the Students page, and then selected when sharing the Exam.

  • What is Start-By Date & Time?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    This is the date and time till when the Exam can be started by Students.
    Note that Students could still be writing exams for exam duration + the Start-By time.
    So if Start-By time is 6:00PM today and the exam duration is 60 minutes, then Students can still start the exam just before 6:00PM and take it till just before 7:00PM, at the latest.

  • Can Exams be shared via a link and also assigned to a set of Students?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Exams will either have a Link or be assinged to a set of Students, cannot be both.

  • How to assign the Exam to a set of Students?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Students who are supposed to take an exam are selected from a combination of one or more Branches, Classes & Centres
    For example, Students can belong to Branch "IIT-JEE", Class "12" and Centre "Main, Mumbai" and all Students in this combination are Selected.
    Can further select or deselect students from this list manually.
    For more info on Branches, Classes

  • What are Class, Centre & Group?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Class or Standard is a number showing the Class of the student, for example 11 indicates, 11th Class/Standard. It can also refer to a batch year like 2023 Batch.
    Centre refers to the location of the student, it can hold a Centre name & City name, for example “Hauz-Khas, New Delhi”
    Group or branch can be any descriptor to group students, for example IIT, NEET, CET, Olympiad etc.,

Frequently Asked Questions

close
  • What are Analytics?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Analytics are Student-wise exam data generated based on their performance and contain various metrics like Ranks, Percentiles, Subject-wise scores, Subject-wise accuracy, Topic-wise accuracy, Question-wise accuracy and much more.
    In the table above, only Ranks and Scores are shown. Clicking on any Student in the table above will show in-depth analytics per Subject.

  • When are Analytics Generated?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Analytics are auto-generated after the exam time closes, which is Start-by time + Exam duration + 60 min grace period.
    It is done this way because generating analytics will make the Key public to Students, so it's best to generate analytics after everyone has completed the exam.

  • Can an Analytics be generated on demand?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Yes analytics can be generated at anytime after atleast one attempt is present, with the green "Generate Analytics" button above
    This must be done carefully as generating analytics once will make the Key public to the Students who have taken the exam.

  • Can an Analytics be downloaded as an Excel file?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Yes, there is an option to Download Analytics, by using the green "Download" button above the list of analytics

  • Where can Students see their Analytics?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    After logging in, Students can see Analytics for all exams they have taken in the "Analysis" page in their left panel.
    To see analytics in this page, Exam Analytics must be generated and be visible to Students.
    In total, 4 pages of Analytics are generated per exam giving in-depth information about the Student's performance in the exam.

  • Can an Analytics be hidden from Students?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Yes, there is an option to "Hide Analytics" inside "Advanced Options", in the "SHARE" tab at the top.
    Doing this will make this exam's analytics invisible to Students who have taken the exam.

Frequently Asked Questions

close
  • What is an Attempt?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    A Student taking an Exam is an Attempt. Once Students start taking the Exam, the above card will contain a list of all those exam attempts.
    So the Admin can see at anytime how many Students are taking the exam, who started the exam when, who submitted when etc.,
    Clicking on an Attempt in the list also shows the Responses saved by the Student and other info like their IP address and Device.

  • How to know the number of Attempts in the Exam?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    The number of attempts in the Exam are shown in brackets in the Attempts tab at the top.
    For example, "Attempts (25)" means that 25 students have attempted this exam till now.

  • Can an Attempt be Deleted?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Yes an attempt can be deleted by clicking on the Student name in the Attempts list and then selecting Delete at the bottom.
    This lets the Student retake the exam and removes their previous attempt.
    Note that deleted Attempts are still counted towards monthly usage.

  • What are Exam Absentees?
    keyboard_arrow_right

    Absentees are Students who were assigned the exam, but who have not yet attempted the exam.
    This is useful in case the Admin wants to notify Students to take the exam, before the Exam time closes.

How-to Create Question Paper PDF

1. In Word Document, Delete everything before Question No. 1

2. Remove all Borders, Header/Footer & Subject Titles

3. To get 1 Question per Page (Applicable if Word File has Question Number followed by a dot and a Tab-Space)

  • CTRL+H to open Find & Replace
  • Select More >> then Select Wildcards
  • Find: [0-9]{1,3}\.^t
  • Replace: ^m^t
  • Replace All

4. Cross-check & then Save as PDF

    Frequently Asked Questions

    close
    • What kinds of questions are supported on EZexam?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Exams can have questions with one or more of the following types:

      • Multiple Choice Questions (single or multi-correct) with 4, 5 or 6 options (ABCD, ABCDE, ABCDEF) are supported.
      • Numercial Questions with Integer (2), Decimal (2.45) or Fractional (2/5) Keys are supported.
      • Subjective exams where Students type in Input or upload Photos with written reponses are supported. For these Exams, Admins have to manually assign marks per question after the exam is submitted by the Student.
      • True or False Questions are supported
      • Audio Questions are also supported
      • Many special types of Exams with 10 of 15 questions to attempt or 5 of 10 questions to attempt are supported.

    • Can my questions contain Pictures or Complex Math?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      If exam questions contain complex math or chemical equations or images to describe the question, then click on "Add Questions via..." and select either "Image & Text Questions" or "Questions in PDF, Key in Excel"
      In "Image & Text Questions", questions are added one after another and questions can be typed in and/or image attached.
      In "Questions in PDF, Key in Excel", a PDF needs to be created with 1 Question per page (including ABCD Options if present) and a corresponding Excel file with Question details like Key, Subject, Marking etc.,
      This is much more versatile letting you manually create Exam Sections.

    • Can I divide my Exam into Sections?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Questions in the Online Exam are automatically grouped into Sections by their assigned Subjects.
      In "Questions in PDF, Key in Excel" option, Sections can be added in the Key file, for example "Maths 1", "Maths 2", "Maths 3" instead of just "Maths" which is created automatically.

    • Can I add my own Subjects?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Yes, you can add your own Subjects in the Settings page in the life Sidebar
      After adding Subjects, they will be selectable in the Subject dropdown per Question and can be used in your Key Files.

    • What is a Topic?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Questions can be assigned Topics, so that Students can see Topic-wise analytics after an exam.
      This is optional and can be left blank.

    • What is Question Difficulty?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Questions can be assigned Difficulty levels of Easy, Medium & Hard.
      If assigned, Students can see how many Easy, Medium and Hard questions they answered accurately.
      This is optional and can be left blank.

    • What are Partial Marks?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      If an MCQ question has more than one answer, then partial marks can be assigned for every correct option selected by the Student.
      For example, assume A B C options are correct from A B C D, and Partial marks are 1 and Correct marks are 4.
      If student response is A B, then 1 mark is given for each correct option, so 2 marks in this case.
      If student response is A B C, then response and key are identical, so 4 marks are given.
      If student reponse contains D, Negative marks are given, irrespective of any other options selected.

    • Can Offline Exams be conducted on EZexam?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Yes, offline MCQ exams can be conducted using OMRs and the EzOMR App is used to evaluate them. All this is integerated into your EZexam portal.
      Simply select an OMR PDF to print from over 20 OMRs, which can be found when creating an OMR exam.
      Then after conducting the exam, scan the OMRs using the EzOMR App for which your account is already created.
      These OMRs are evaluated and automatically appear in your exam in this portal, with scores and corrected OMR images.

    • Can EZexam be customized?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Yes your EZexam portal address can be customized with your name, like my-institute.ezexam.in and the colors and logos can be set.
      Web-App icon can also be set for mobile devices, giving it a customized look like it's your own website.
      This customization is free of charge.

    • What kinds of Exams are supported on EZexam?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      All common examinations held in India are supported, including IIT-JEE, NEET, CET, GATE, GRE and many more.
      These include latest advanced features such as answering 10 of 15 questions in a section, calculators for GRE/GATE, setting timer per section and many more.
      Offline OMR Exams can also be created with EZexam and the EzOMR App is also included, which is used to scan and evaluate OMRs and the results are automatically sent to your EZexam account.

    • What kinds of questions are supported on EZexam?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Exams can have questions with one or more of the following types:

      • Multiple Choice Questions (single or multi-correct) with 4, 5 or 6 options (ABCD, ABCDE, ABCDEF) are supported.
      • Numercial Questions with Integer (2), Decimal (2.45) or Fractional (2/5) Keys are supported.
      • Subjective exams where Students type in Input or upload Photos with written reponses are supported. For these Exams, Admins have to manually assign marks per question after the exam is submitted by the Student.
      • True or False Questions are supported
      • Audio Questions are also supported
      • Many special types of Exams with 10 of 15 questions to attempt or 5 of 10 questions to attempt are supported.

    • Does EZexam provide Question Content?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      EZexam is an Online Exam System, we do not provide any content for Exams.
      All the Questions required for an exam have to be added by the Institute Admins.

    • Are there any limitations to EZexam usage?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      EZexam is made to be scalable and any number of Students can take exams on it simultaneously.
      Any number of Exams can be created, without limits
      Any number of Students can be added, without limits
      100 Attempts per month are Free and beyond that, can purchase Attempts per your requirement for as low as Rs.1/attempt when you add 2500 Attempts.

    • Is my data Secure on EZexam?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      All data transfer on EZexam is completely encrypted using SSL which can be seen in the lock symbol in the address bar
      EZexam runs on industry leading servers with state-of-the-art security.
      Rest assured your data is absolutely secure on EZexam and has been for all our clients, since our inception over 5 years ago.

    • Is my data Private on EZexam?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      We take Data Privacy very seriously and rest assured, your data, be it your content or student data, is not shared with anyone, in any manner by EZexam
      Institute or Student data is not monetized by us and it is not part of our business model.
      Your data is yours and only you have access to it, no one else can view it in whole or parts.
      We can even sign NDAs (Non-Disclosure Agreements) with Institutes or Organizations if they so choose.

    • Can Students view their Exam Scores & Analytics?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Yes, students login to the same portal as you do, on any device, with their Roll Numbers or Phone Numbers (if added).
      Here they will be able to take Exams, view Scores & Analytics after the exam is taken.

    • Can Offline Exams be conducted on EZexam?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Yes, offline MCQ exams can be conducted using OMRs and the EzOMR App is used to evaluate them. All this is integerated into your EZexam portal.
      Simply select an OMR PDF to print from over 20 OMRs, which can be found when creating an OMR exam.
      Then after conducting the exam, scan the OMRs using the EzOMR App for which your account is already created.
      These OMRs are evaluated and automatically appear in your exam in this portal, with scores and corrected OMR images.

    • Can EZexam be customized?
      keyboard_arrow_right

      Yes your EZexam portal address can be customized with your name, like my-institute.ezexam.in and the colors and logos can be set.
      Web-App icon can also be set for mobile devices, giving it a customized look like it's your own website.
      This customization is free of charge.
